title: Reading Corso's The Day After Roswell
summary: John Blitch tells of Reading Corso's The Day After Roswell, about 1997 at Roswell, New Mexico, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency for advanced technology, told podcast host Jesse Michels that around 1997 he read The Day After Roswell. That is a book by Philip J. Corso, a former Army officer, about the claimed 1947 crash of a UFO near Roswell, New Mexico. Blitch says it was then that he really started digging into the subject.
